items.title: UK armed forces intercept Russian 'shadow fleet' tanker
items.description: The British armed forces have intercepted the sanctioned oil tanker in a bid to disrupt the oil revenue ​that helps fund Russia's war in Ukraine.

items.title: Live: Piastri loses early gain, F1 championship leader pledges 'full attack'
items.description: Oscar Piastri has work to do in Spain, starting tonight's Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix from seventh on the grid. Follow live.

items.title: The Socceroos' greatest ever World Cup gamble just paid off
items.description: With his first World Cup team selection, Tony Popovic produced one of the biggest shocks in Socceroos' history. After 90 minutes against Türkiye, his gamble was vindicated.

items.title: Fair Work rejects gas giant's claim strikes would harm the economy
items.description: One of Australia's biggest gas producers has lost a bid to stop industrial action at its Darwin facilities after claiming strikes would force shutdowns and cause significant damage to the nation's economy.

items.title: Luai leads Tigers to epic final Leichhardt win
items.description: Jarome Luai has lead the Wests Tigers to a win in their final match at Leichhardt Oval before it's redevelopment.

items.title: Ryan kicks six as Saints get home in GWS thriller at Docklands
items.description: Liam Ryan kicks half a dozen goals as St Kilda earns a thrilling eight-point win over Greater Western Sydney, after Brisbane's victory in Hobart over the Tigers.

items.title: Paddleboarder says shark attack victim he helped save was 'very unlucky'
items.description: An off-duty volunteer lifeguard who pulled a woman from the ocean after she was bitten by a shark reveals how he helped save her life while in a state of "panic" himself.

items.title: Police officer in custody after Perth girl shot dead overseas
items.description: A nine-year-old Perth girl has been fatally shot by police in Pakistan after officers mistook her family's car for that of suspected criminals.

items.title: No Medicare, no family, no visa — these are the babies Australia doesn't count
items.description: For the Pacific Islander women who harvest the fruit and vegetables that stock Australia’s supermarket shelves, motherhood here can mean injury, debt, secrecy and fear.

items.title: The obscure laws Trump is using to reshape Washington in his image
items.description: Project by project, Donald Trump is altering the United States capital, and in some cases, disrupting views and design that date back more than two centuries.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers

items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].
